result.detail: run-0001 and run-0002 are the triage stage's runs, which I cite as inputs. I ran no tools myself. The reproduction gate (simulator.run with expect=fail, run by the platform) and the independent review are still outstanding. Tracing: the start pulse is set on a falling edge, so the following rising edge samples it. With the frame's start accepted at rising edge P0, the interfering pulse is sampled at P11, inside data bit 1 (P8..P12). Bit 2 is loaded at P12 from the overwritten hold. Samples fall at falling edges n2 (start), n6+4i (data bit i) and n38 (stop), all inside their bit windows. Two uncertainty drivers: the regression's failing check is not identified in the evidence, and the nonce plusarg name is unspecified.; dropped runs not made for this task: run-0001, run-0002
